//: EXAMPLE DEVOTION FILE — copy this as a starting point for a new Discover devotion.
//lives: src/Respondeo.Content.Discover/wwwroot/discover/devotions/. Register the file name in devotions/devotions-manifest.json so DevotionService loads it.
//structure: A devotion is an ordered sequence of steps that reference prayers by id, plus optional selectable mystery sets. The interactive player walks the sequence, so a new devotion is pure data — no code change. Every prayerId must refer to an existing prayer file.
//bead: Optional 'bead' on a step draws a marker on the left rosary thread: 'cross' (Sign of the Cross), 'medal' (centerpiece medal), 'large' (Our Father bead), 'small' (Hail Mary bead), or 'between' (three small pips for prayers said between beads). Omit for spoken steps not prayed on a bead.
title: The Example Devotion
//sortKey: OPTIONAL. Filing key used when the browse page sorts by title. Set it when the display title should sort differently from how it reads (e.g. a title leading with 'The'/'A'/'An'). Defaults to title.
summary: A one-line description shown on cards.
intro: Markdown introduction shown before the reader begins. Explain the devotion's origin and when it is prayed.

mysterySets.name: The Five Decades
mysterySets.when: Optional note on when this set is prayed (e.g. Mondays and Saturdays).

mysteries.title: First Decade
mysteries.reflection: Optional *Markdown* meditation shown for this mystery.
